tools.name: rooflink_list_jobs
tools.description: List the jobs (leads and sales) of the company, paginated. GET /light/public/jobs/.

tools.name: rooflink_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by id: customer, status, address and dates. GET /light/public/jobs/{id}/.

tools.name: rooflink_search_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs by text, status, sales rep, creation date, zip code or customer region. GET /light/jobs/paginated_search/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers of the company, paginated, with filters for sales rep and region. GET /light/customers/.

tools.name: rooflink_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id: name, contact details and addresses. GET /light/customers/{id}/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_todos
tools.description: List the to-dos (tasks) of the company, paginated, with filters for employee, job, priority and completion. GET /light/todos/.

tools.name: rooflink_get_todo
tools.description: Get one to-do by id: name, notes, assignee, job and completion state. GET /light/todos/{id}/.

tools.name: rooflink_create_todo
tools.description: Create a to-do for one employee, optionally linked to a job. Not idempotent: a repeated call creates a second to-do. POST /light/todos/.

tools.name: rooflink_set_todo_completed
tools.description: Mark one to-do as complete (true) or open again (false). Repeating the same call gives the same result. POST /light/todos/{id}/complete/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_events
tools.description: List the calendar events of the company, paginated, by start date range, job or employee. GET /light/events/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_estimates
tools.description: List the estimates of the company, paginated, by job or text. GET /light/estimates/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded in the company, paginated, by job or text. GET /light/payments/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_notes
tools.description: List the notes of the company, paginated, by job, employee, read state or text. GET /light/notes/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees of the company, paginated, with an active filter. Use user.id from a row as the to-do assignee. GET /light/employees/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_crews
tools.description: List the installation crews of the company, paginated, by active state, trade, region or text. GET /light/crews/.

tools.name: rooflink_list_work_orders
tools.description: List the work orders of the company, paginated, by crew, job, start or completion dates, or text. GET /light/workorders/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rooflink_set_todo_completed · Private data: rooflink_get_customer · Public sink: rooflink_create_todo, rooflink_set_todo_completed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rooflink_set_todo_completed · Private data: rooflink_get_customer · Public sink: rooflink_create_todo, rooflink_set_todo_completed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
